I just used the dog wash service for the first time and honestly, both me and my dog loved it.

The equipment is excellent - really powerful shower and blow dryer - so you can get everything done much faster and much more thoroughly than you can do at home.

They provide everything- apron, brush, towel, shampoo and conditioner.

My dog has never been so fluffy in such a short space of time.

The best £16 I’ve spent in ages.

100% will be back.

I was recommended this company by a friend so had high hopes we finally found somewhere locally where we could take our dogs for some training/lessons. I therefore phoned to enquire about the services they offer and their availability as their website doesn’t provide a booking function and requests you contact them for further information. The woman I spoke to took lots of details regarding my dogs and advised she would pass the message on to the dog trainer who would get back in touch shortly. I unfortunately never heard anything back and after two weeks I decided to give them another call and explain the situation and that we had not heard back from them. The woman who I spoke to on this occasion (who was different from the first woman) apologised and took our details again and advised the dog trainer was due to arrive in the next hour and that I could expect a call back thereafter the same day. It has again been two weeks and I have still not recieved a call back therefore I will take the hint that they clearly are not interested in our business (their loss). If I could I would give 0 stars due to the lack of basic customer care we have experienced. Good luck to anyone else who tries to enquire about arranging dog training 👍🏻
Absolutely fantastic. My dog looks amazing and the staff are so lovely.

Review for Wizard of Paws Grooming Service

I booked my dog Maisie in for a full groom after being happy with the result the first time I used this salon. They had a cancellation and were able to fit her in quickly, which I appreciated.

Unfortunately this visit was a very different experience. I had asked for “short all over like last time, with a fluffy face” and the tail left slightly longer. When my daughter collected Maisie after the groom, it was finished in about 1½ hours (normally it takes around 3 hours), and the cut looked very uneven. The tail had been left extremely long, the ears were very long, and the face looked disproportionate with bits sticking out.

My daughter returned to the shop to politely ask if the ears, tail and face could be trimmed shorter. The staff did make adjustments, but when Maisie came home the groom was still very uneven — one ear noticeably longer than the other, her face choppy, and one front leg with more hair than the other. Overall the cut looked poorly balanced.

I emailed afterwards simply asking if I could come in to discuss it as I was disappointed and confused, particularly because the groom had been excellent the first time I visited. Instead of being offered a conversation or solution, I received a lengthy email telling me that I was no longer welcome to bring my dog back.

I completely understand that communication about grooming styles can sometimes be tricky, but I feel that raising concerns politely about an uneven groom should not result in being dismissed as a customer. I would have much preferred a constructive conversation or an offer to correct the issues.

It’s a shame because my first experience here was great, but unfortunately this second visit and the response to my concerns left me very disappointed.
